description: Training-year applicability table of the gated nighttime penalty term (gate[kp_class, month, local_time_bin, latitude_band]). Rebuilt on CPU (NumPy 2.4.6) the file was byte-identical to the recorded one; the arrays are also compared by content, in case another NumPy version writes different zip headers.
made_by: scripts/prepare_night_gate.py (tecfc/objectives/night_gate.py derive; training years 2009-2012, 2014, 2016, 2018 and the penalty driver store)
content_digest: sha256 over dtype.str + "|" + str(shape) + "|" + array bytes, per array

definition.eligible: internal transitions h=0..10 of each training target day; cosSZA(h)<=1e-6 at the start (same mask and driver store as the loss); both TEC values finite
definition.kp_class: Kp at the transition start from the frozen penalty driver store: 0 (<3), 1 (3 to <5), 2 (>=5)
definition.month: calendar month of the target day (UTC)
definition.local_time_bin: floor(((UTC hour of the start + longitude/15) mod 24)/2), 12 bins
definition.latitude_band: floor((latitude+90)/10), 18 bands from 90S to 90N; the 73rd longitude column is the +180 copy
definition.gate: 1 if count >= 1000 and increase fraction <= 0.25, else 0
